description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_table} function, which generates an HTML table from an array of data with customizable attributes and layout options.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_table
methods.description: Generates an HTML table from provided data and parameters, with options for layout, attributes, and captions.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_table_cycle
methods.description: Cycles through attribute arrays for table headers, rows, or cells to apply styles or classes.
